notes: בְּתוֹךְ is written in two English words here, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits the preposition from its construct noun; the rectum's article takes the the standing before its own word (rule 29).
The suffix of עָלָיו resumes the fronted Jahaziel, whom the ASV names once, so the suffix is unrepresented (rule 22).
